name: Guardian Enforcer
purpose: Deterministic release gate for CardNest programs, agents, code changes, card data, and production assets.
principles: security and user privacy before automation
automaticBlockers: duplicate card number
duplicate permanent card id
missing canonical card
unexpected clan, rarity, or battle class
production card asset reused by a different card
Season One card silently changed to released
Season One card silently changed to pack eligible
obvious committed live secret
missing or invalid visual theme
theme used as creature identity in public copy
battle class icon does not match canonical battle class
legacy clan/theme mismatch
theme badge icon does not match canonical visual theme
commercial sales enabled while launch-readiness gate is closed
founder tools exposed without server authorization
commercial sales enabled before CardNest name clearance approval
registered trademark symbol used before registration is confirmed
affiliate redirect points to an unapproved hostname
affiliate shopping link is active without explicit partner approval
affiliate shopping UI lacks a clear commission disclosure
humanApprovalRequired: switch Stripe or another payment provider to live mode
change a Season One card to released
make a Season One card pack eligible
approve public support and customer-request process
approve unit economics for paid packs
change CardNest brand-clearance status to approved
file or authorize a trademark application
activate TCGplayer affiliate links after network acceptance
activate eBay Partner Network links after network acceptance
failureMode: fail closed for canonical integrity, release-state, exact duplicate production assets, and exposed secrets; report warnings for creative near-collisions requiring review
